nom: The Ordinary UV Filters SPF 45 Serum

avis.texte: i like it. i just don't use a ton of this product because it leaves my face oily. i don't consider it a glow because i already have oily skin in my t zone areas. i personally just do not like that look for me. i recommend applying it to other areas like your neck or hands if you don't like the way it sits on your face throughout the day.

I had high hopes when I purchased this item at Ulta. The SPF coverage of 45 is effective to prevent the harmful UV rays. However, the formula is separating before I even use it for the first time, and after a few shakes, I tried it on my face. It was so greasy and my makeup would not stay on top of it. This is a badly formulated product and i would not recommend it to anyone. It's much better to buy Korean sunscreen products, or better, go abroad and buy a few. The FDA here limited the ingredients so much that anything manufactured in the US is not as good as the Korean ones. I passed the return window period. Too bad.

I dont like sun screen in makeup at all. Skin tints/foundation etc. I decided to try this and I love it. Gives me a nice glow, and sits well under makeup. After blending it out it does look very glowy, but as you let it sink in, it turns out very nice. I dont think I will change try other sunscreens to be honest.
I wanted to try it out because I really love the brand but it was such a bad choice. My skin go so irritated and dry,once the sun hit my face it would burn . My sick had never been this bad.
Use the sun screen for just a couple of days abd it clogged my pores and irritated my screen
This product works so well under makeup, so smooth, shiny finish. Overall, amazing product.

Didnt like the texture of this sunscreen. Its very runny and shinny. But i guess it says ot in the bottle - its a serum. It makes my eyes sting. I ended up keeping it in my car for touch ups. But wont be repurchasing.
I love this product. It glides on well and does not leave a white cast on my face. Light, but full coverage. I will continue to buy it!
I'm not very sensitive when it comes to make-up, but something in this makes my eyes BURN. ok solution, I gave to my fiance. He also had MASSIVE burning around his eyes.
Great for acne prone and mature skin. Works well with skin serums and makeup. I like how it gives my skin a healthy glow and It doesn't look ashy on African American skin. This product gets and A++
This product goes on smooth. It is slightly oiler than anticipated. I am using this after moisture.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I got this sunscreen last year and I've been using it since then. A few weeks ago the sun was so bright and it was so hot I thought my skin was going to sizzle away, but I didn't get any sunburn! I am planning on restocking again once I run out
My absolute favorite sunscreen. I will only use this one. Makes my skin feel non-oily and great coverage.
Bought this hoping it wouldn't make my foundation separate(which ot didn't) but it broke me out so bad. Red dry itching bumps all over my face and neck.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This is such an amazing sunscreen. It glides on the skin, is not too sticky, and doesn't leave a white cast. Kinda off a dupe for kiehl's sunscreen.

Although I only wanted to stick to THE ORDINARY line of facial products this SPF 45 Serum burned my face slightly when I used it. I thought about taking it back but kept it because I want to give it a fair chance. It feels very light weight on your face; I'd like something a little heavier. I wouldn't say don't buy because it a personal preference. Light fragrance and feels smooth it's just not for me.
I like but don't love this product. It gets the job done but is a little heavier that I would prefer. It has caused some pilling with makeup application. Good but not great.

avis.titre: I would not recommend to people with sensitive skin
avis.texte: This product made my face burn, and gave me patchy dry and itchy skin on my face.
Pump would not work for sunscreen. I know it's can happen bit its annoying..I placed my order online to save a trip going into store but will end up there anyway.

Broke me out so badly I thought I was having an allergic reaction! After just two uses, my face and neck were covered in tiny bumps. Definitely not sensitive skin friendly. The pump also didnt seem to work super well and wouldnt fully rise back up between pumps.
I wanted to love this so much! I loved the glow it gave me, but after just a few days I developed contact dermatitis from it.

I double cleanse every morning. I also add no more than two serums of my choice (depending on how my skin is acting that day) after toner. I have tried this multiple times with different serums and moisturizers that usually work with other products in my routine. This product has always managed to build up into balls of product on my face then flake off throughout the day. As someone with acne prone and oily skin, this is a BIG no.

I couldn't believe how fast my skin went downhill using this product. For context I have a normal skin type, sometimes tending towards dry, and have never experienced a reaction to a skincare product. This SPF gets 1 extra star because I liked the consistency and it settled well without leaving a white cast on me (though I am very fair.) Everything else has been awful in my personal experience. Day one was perfectly fine, but by the end of day two using this sunscreen every inch of my skin was covered in small, itchy under the skin bumps. I can tell it was this product because even my neck and hands where I applied the excess are broken out. Such a waste and an unbelievable experience from The Ordinary considering how highly regarded they are by myself and many others.

As a sensitive and *very* fair skinned girly, I must say that this works to preven sunburn. I bought this so that I could stop putting body sunscreen on my face and was a little skeptical because I sunburn very easily. I took it to Mexico and did not have any sunburn on my face, neck or ears where this was applied. Highly recommend!
I like it so far I been using this since October 2025 the only thing I don't like is feels heavy I have to wait long period of time to be able to put makeup on

avis.titre: Exactly what I've been looking for.
avis.texte: This product is light, odorless, and perfect on my sensitive skin. It works great under makeup (no pilling, no weirdness). It's not super greasy, doesn't leave a white caste. High spf, and at a reasonable cost. No notes.

I tried this sunscreen cause I liked the price-point and enjoy all The Ordinary products I have tried, when I tell you this is the worst sunscreen I have ever put in my face... believe me. My skin burned and broke out so horribly and is still recovering after a week. I have oily skin but I would describe my sensitivity as normal. I genuinely am so disappointed in this product, and advise anyone, ever to read all these reviews and stay away.
Love the lightweight of this serum like sunscreen. Hydrating and works well under makeuo. Gives that glass look people are always trying to achieve.

Have very sensitive acne prone skin at age 45 I get regular facials and need to wear sunwcreen at all times, i love this becaue it doesnt smell like sunscreen Soft and easy to apply i dont get a cakey feeling all day I wear it over moisturizer and it sit well, I dont use it at the beach as i feel that i can still get burned but for daily wear its a must!
This product made me break out horribly. I would not recommend for sensitive skin.
My skin is very picky about SPF produxts, this one doesn't feel heavy and greasy like most others. Doesn't break my skin out either. Lightweight and comfortable. Will most likely re-purchase.
If someone asks me for a good non greasy moisturizer that doesn't feel like sandpaper, I recommend this product.

avis.titre: Great SPF that works well under makeup with no pilling
avis.texte: I tried over 30 different sunscreens, using the recommended amount of 1/2 teaspoon, and they were all causing my makeup to pill..some minor pilling others severe, even after waiting 30 minutes to dry. The ordinary SPF 45 serum worked like magic. I waited 10 minutes and it was as if I was applying my makeup directly on my skin. It also stayed on beautifully the rest of the day.
I like the ordinary products but this didn't hit the mark for me. The formula of this product felt heavy and made my break out. Because of that I won't be buying again.
I did like the feeling of this sunscreen and found it not to be too heavy. Unfortunately it caused my under eye concealer to break and appear patchy, I won't be purchasing again.

avis.titre: buying this again as soon as I run out!
avis.texte: as someone with medium to tan skin that's acne prone and very oily, this sunscreen sits so well on my face!! it blends in perfectly with no white cast!! which is something I'm so happy to have found in a sunscreen product. I have been using The Ordinary products for about three years now and I'm happy to say I haven't been disappointed by any of their products.

bought on a whim because I wanted to try it out. i did not know i would love this product! I love The Ordinary, great products at great prices. so i love that it doesnt burn my eyes, and there is no white cast. it does give that glowy effect after you apply it but its not too glowy. the consistency of product is more on the thinner side, its not as thick as a lotion and not too thin like an oil. the only con that i have is that i wish it came in a bigger size.

I love this SPF serum. It doesn't leave a white cast! It goes on thick and looks SLIGHTLY shiny when you first put it on (I like this so I can see where I missed). But it totally melts into the skin after a minute and is great all day. Can't feel it!

I used this and broke out with a lot tiny bumps. I have normal to dry skin. Unfortunately it took a few days to realize it this product. I would definitely recommend doing a patch test if you want to try this product out.

This is just basically normal sunscreen but kind of runny. Its a little greasy but I don't mind as I have dry skin. The absolute worst part about it though is that if I sweat at all in the first couple hours after applying the product will run into my eyes and it hurts so much. It feels just like when you get normal sunscreen in your eyes

I'm in my early 20's and have combination, acne prone skin. I'm afriad this product is awful. I wore it consistently for one week, applied every morning, and wore it for half a day. Not only is it super greasy if you use the correct amount (two fingers worth of product), but on the last day I used it, my entire face had produced tiny oily bumps, or clogged pores. They're still taking their sweet time going away.
Unfortunately broke my skin out in a very quick manner! Combo skin. Super bummer.

Please do not get this product, it completely turned my face into a bumpy itchy mess and it's seriously caused me a lot of stress. My entire face is itchy and bumpy, it's awful lol. I don't use sunscreen and I was recommended this product by an ulta employee, it's terrible.
This sunscreen worked well with my combination skin type. It doesn't leave a white cast, is lightweight (but a little too watery imo), and goes a long way. I like the pump applicator as well.

I've been using this sunscreen for a couple of months and love it! I've used much pricier sunscreens and this one is just as good! It's not thick, goes on smoothly and gives a beautiful light glow. Perfect especially if your skin is on the dry side.

Not a fan of the texture. It's verrrry emollient and greasy. It's thin-ish but I wouldn't call it a serum. I could forgive the greasiness, but this sunscreen burns my eyes every time I wear it. I will be only using it on my neck and decollete.

avis.titre: If you're acne prone, skip it
avis.texte: I really like this brand and use a lot of stuff from them, but for some reason every time I tried this sunscreen it made me break out!
I love how the sunscreen feels on my face after my morning routine. I like the brand and the price.
great product it really helps me skin and also protects me from the sun

This is not my favorite spf. It is not a serum consistency. It's quite heavy and stays sitting on the skin. I thought it was a chemical sunscreen, which should sink into the skin well. This doesn't act like a chemical sunscreen at all. It is heavy and I can feel it on my skin the whole day. Very greasy too.

avis.titre: 100% worst skincare product I've ever bought.
avis.texte: I have used the ordinary skincare products for over a year now and love them! I've never had more clear skin. I saw they came out with an SPF and I was so excited. Immediately bought it and started using it. Within the first hour of using it my face started to break out. I stopped using it but the damage was done. My face and neck are now covered in bumps. I have never had a skincare product do this to my skin, and it doesn't seem to be getting better. Please save ur money and your face and do a test patch on your arm or something. Or better just skip out on this product.

I know some people were complaining about greasy heavy feel on certain skin types. I have oily skin at baseline and I felt like this sunscreen is so light weight/elegant on the skin. I'm in my 30s and feel like my skin is more prone to dehydration lately. So applying this feels more like a hydrating hug. I don't feel it on my skin throughout the day. Spreads easily like a dream despite using typical American filters. Glow is stunning and enhances my makeup bases. I think they did an excellent job formulating this sunscreen and it is my new favorite daily go to.

avis.titre: the lightest weight sunscreen I have ever seen
avis.texte: As with the Ordinary products I have tried thus far I have been especially happy with this - is super lightweight, absorbs into my skin and does not leave the dreaded white residue

avis.titre: Spf moisturizer I've been looking for!!
avis.texte: I have acne prone skin and was hesitant trying this but it works so good! it's moisturizing and it gave my skin a healthy glow. I received so many compliments on how beautiful my skin looked. now I don't even wear foundation. Please continue to make this moisturizer. 😊🙏🏽

avis.titre: Get small outbreaks of acne, get away from this product.
avis.texte: I don't recommend it, I got Acne in my face. I will definitely return to my La Roche Possey serum.

avis.titre: DO NOT BUY IF ACNE PRONE
avis.texte: I've been on the lookout for SPF specifically for oily-acne prone skin and this deserves no hype. ESPECIALLY for people with acne. I already have active hormonal acne and this "SPF Serum" made it worse. It's very runny and greasy at first, takes time to dry down, and broke me out within days. SAVE your money and pass this sunscreen please.

I know all skin is different but this works great for my skin. I'm prone to breakouts and have combination skin. This worked well as both a sunscreen and very effective moisturizer for me. I don't wear make-up so not sure how make-up would build on top of this. It goes on VERY greasy but then blends in and I never felt oily. I'm on my second bottle.

Feels like a glowy serum that smooths out the skin. Its a staple in my routine now under makeup and looks flawless. However i would not reccommend this to someone with oily skin, it may become too greasy for you.

its not as good as the supergoop one ive dried but this one is still decent. Its very lightweight and not overly oily. Its not a mineral sunscreen so it isnt tinted but it doesnt leave a white cast, at least on me. (I'm VERY pale). I live in Arizona but I havent noticed this has been sweat off or anything. Not sure how waterproof it is.
There is quite literally nothing special about this - it's a normal sunscreen that they've just called a serum. If anything it's worse than normal bc it's greasy. Not worth the price whatsoever.

I love this sunscreen and use it daily! I use it under the elf hydrogrip primer and dont have issues with it breaking. My skin leans towards combo and it hasnt caused any breakouts. Purchased twice now!

I wanted to like this so bad but i did break out probably because it's sticky and greasy. Will use on other parts of my body to not let it go to waste but unfortunately will stick with my beauty of joseon

I tried this on my hand in store before purchasing and thought it'd be hydrating and easy to blend. Once I tried it on my face, I found it to be way too oily! I had to powder my face to feel like I could go outside, which I never do. Immediately returned it.

avis.titre: Would be great if it didn't cause massive breakout
avis.texte: As someone with combination, sensitive, deep brown skin, finding a daily SPF is a constant battle. I need an SPF that doesn't pill on top of my morning skin care and wears well under makeup without causing too much oilyness or my makeup to shift (a little bit is unavoidable) and doesn't break me out. I double cleanse every night. Anything that I have had some success with is super expensive, so at this price point I had to try it. Initially, I was pleased. It wears really well, with and without makeup and does not leave a white cast. However, after about a week+ I suddenly had a severe acne breakout. The only thing I had changed in my routine was the SPF. The acne is deep and painful and a deal-breaker for this product. The price was too good to be true.
Made me a grease ball, maybe would work if you have dry skin 😬

avis.titre: Greasy, not worth it. Had high hopes.
avis.texte: It's a sunscreen, thats for sure. But this one had me looking greasier than I EVER have been. I hoped this wouldnt be greasy since this was a serum, and as someone with oily skin I usually use mineral sunscreens. But oh my god this looks DISGUSTING on the skin, its the equivalent of rubbing straight up burger king grease on my skin. DO NOT BUY!!
This sunscreen has made my face have a pretty bad reaction. I only used this for 2 days and it made my skin very irritated. It's all over my face but definitely a lot more on my cheeks sadly.
I would not buy unless you like everything your face comes in contact with to have white greasy film on it.

Used this twice and my skin had a bad allergic reaction. I broke out, I had bumps all over my face. I'm not sure which exact ingredient in here broke me out but I do not recommend this for people who have dry + normal skin.
Used this consistently and evrrytime i used it, my face woukd itch and burn for the ahole day. Its convenient but snells whenever you pump it out
This is a staple in my morning routine. It takes a while but it mixes well with my moisturizer and leaves me looking very glowy and it lasts.

Used this once and that evening washing my face my skin felt tender. The next morning a rash of small bumps mainly on my chin and forehead but throughout the day spread over my face and the next day continued to spread down/around my neck and down to my chest. I dont consider myself to have sensitive skin but I am on the normal to dry side. Becareful if you have sensitive skin, try a patch test

I am seriously in love with this stuff! I struggle with fungal acne and tend to have dry-combo skin. I use it nearly every single day. It soaks into my skin really well. I haven't had any issues with breakouts and it doesn't dry out my skin.
I really tried to make this sunscreen work but every single time it made my eczema flare up like crazy!! It is also kinda oily so if you have oily skin i definitely wouldn't recommend this.

avis.titre: sits well as a base under make up
avis.texte: I wear really sheer makeup and this sunscreen mixes with it well. it doesnt make my skin feel oily or anything i recommend it

This sunscreen is great! The serum texture is a nice alternative to thick versions. It does appear greasy at first, but after it dries down, it leaves the most beautiful glow. It layers well under makeup. I have sensitive skin and have had no reaction after using for 3 weeks. Highly recommend!

I have normal skin and I found this sunscreen to be super greasy and does not dry down. I'm also relatively active and enjoy running. I would not recommend this sunscreen for active people because it will sweat right off.

i really liked how thin it was, it started oily but would absorb into the skin well. but after a week and a half of using it every morning, i got texture that i hadn't had before and was the only change in the routine :/

avis.titre: Scary at First… but WOW, the Glow!
avis.texte: At first, I was a bit horrified when I applied it, it looked like it had turned into a layer of oil on my skin. But I bought it based on the reviews and my trust in The Ordinary, and I'm so glad I stuck with it! Once it fully absorbed, I was left with a beautiful dewy glow. My skin feels smooth and hydrated, not greasy or sticky at all!
Was excited to try a new sunscreen. Caused a rash from my chest to my face that has not gone away in a week. Never happened to me before

avis.titre: Not the best, I'd go with Sunbum over this any day
avis.texte: I bought this for a backpacking trip and while I didn't burn, I would not get this sunscreen again. It feels especially greasy and although it's easy to blend into the skin, it made me break out badly. Also, if you sweat your face will develop a white cast that doesn't go away.

I have a combination skin (both dry and oily on some parts) and I bought this whenever it first dropped and it has actually made my skin a bit clearer and its been the only thing/new product ive added to my skincare. Its smooth and hydrates it for me it didnt make my skin feel oily. So i feel it might really just depend on your skin:)

I have a combination skin (both dry and oily on some parts) and I bought this whenever it first dropped and it has actually made my skin a bit clearer and its been the only thing/new product ive added to my skincare. Its smooth and hydrates it for me it didnt make my skin feel oily. So i feel it might really just depend on your skin:)

I love the Ordinary products but I hate this one. I have combo skin and although it didn't leave a white cast, my face developed acne after 2 days. It also makes my face look greasy -not glazed-but straight up greasy and gross. If I could return it I would. I'll try it on my body but Im already weary.

i bought this when it first dropped, and i thought i liked how it felt on the skin. but after a few applications, i noticed it would leave a greasy layer that would stay almost all day. i will say it doesnt burn the eyes, but thats about it. would not recommend
I broke out in little white bumps and took a week for them to go away

I wanted to love this especially after so many people recommended it. It glides on smoothly when applying and feels good on the skin. However it appears too greasy on my combo oily skin, stings my eyes, and turns my beads of sweat white. Overall not worth it.
Bought this for my 16 yr old son and found myself using and loving it!

This sunscreen works so well that I have already repurchased! I bought this to take to Mexico and not only does it protect from the sun, it doesn't leave any white cast behind and hydrates your skin. I am a very fair skinned girl and will literally burn anywhere i don't apply sunscreen or have clothing covering me and this works amazing at keeping me from getting sunburnt. This might be a new staple!
Used for 2 days, ended up with a weird rash all over my face and neck. I do not have sensitive skin by any means. Would not recommend to anyone. Really sad about this
To protect from UVA, sunscreen must have zinc or titanium oxidide, which this product doesnt have. This might prevent a burn, but will not prevent sun damage
I love this sunscreen it doesn't leave a white cast and it's not greasy. It leave you looking moisturized

I usually use sunscreens like Biore Aqua Rich Aqua Protect so I was very happy to see TO come out with this serum-type sunscreen. I dont get the "greasy" finish others have but I always shake the bottle before use. Maybe the packaging could be more clear about that step? Or include those mixing balls so you have an audio cue to shake it. I also don't wear a lot of makeup, maybe some BB cream if my skin is red so as far as layering YMMV. It's not sweat proof (and doesnt claim to be) so let it absorb well before going out.

avis.titre: It's not the best but not the worst
avis.texte: I recently purchased this. I love most of the ordinary products and noticed they finally carry sunscreen. When i put it on it feels heavy, then i dont fee it. No white cast shown but it does feel oily, not too much tho. I did have to use an oil sheet once but not sure if ill repurchase again.

avis.titre: It's not the best but not the worst
avis.texte: I recently purchased this. I love most of the ordinary products and noticed they finally carry sunscreen. When i put it on it feels heavy, then i dont fee it. No white cast shown but it does feel oily, not too much tho. I did have to use an oil sheet once but not sure if ill repurchase again.

avis.titre: Bad breakout and bumps on face
avis.texte: I used this only twice and in those 2 days I got painful raised bumps/breakouts which still haven't completely cleared after stopping for over 10 days. Otherwise was okay, left no white cast but would not recommend.

avis.titre: I would repurchase again. Love it.
avis.texte: I love this product! Doesnt have a fragrance which is important for my sensitive skin, and blends seamlessly!

Irritated my eyes as I guess there's no sweat protection but it was during a casual walk outside. Left my face looking and feeling oily/greasy. Face was noticeably shiny and slightly white. Tried it on my arms and that too felt oily/greasy.

This prouduct is very light weight and has a great feel but once applied it is so oily. I have dry skin so i love the glowy look skincare gives but when it looks like i spread butter on my face thats where i draw the line. It even felt greacy and like oil and i couldnt get it off very well.
I have sensitive skin so im always nervous trying a new product but this gave me raised bumps all over my forehead within a couple uses.

This entire spf is a disappointment. The only redeeming quality is that it actually does not leave a white cast. I have very dry skin and typically opt for hydrating formulas. This serum applies thick and oily, sitting heavy on the skin. It gives you a 'glow' but sits like sticky grease all over your face. It never dries down and if you put makeup on top of things slide all over the place. It took me 3 weeks to pin point that this product is what was making me break out so bad! My face started clogging up in small red acne all over. This product is so irritating I cannot even use it on my chest or arms without getting nasty clogged pores. One of the worst experiences with a sunscreen.

This was fine for about 3 days but at the end of the 3rd day I noticed a rough texture to my cheeks and after washing they were a bright pink and very irritated. They still are after using soothing treatment overnight and I have other areas of breakouts across my face. It's getting 2 stars because if it hadn't made my skin react this was a good product, takes a bit to dry down but then is a nice satin finish. I have combo skin, very fair, somewhat sensitive.

This was soooo greasy and heavy. If I didn't quit it immediately, I know it's what would have given me acne on my oily, acne-prone skin. I felt it the whole time and had to wash it off because it felt so gross.

Love everything about the formula, feel, smell, and application of this product but within two days of use, my face and neck are covered in small bumps/red rash. Disappointed to say the least as i usually love the Ordinary.

After 3 days of using this I got the craziest white bumps all over my face and near my eyes. It goes on very oily but dries satin-like. There's something in here that's hypoallergenic. Many reviews mention the same bumps I'm talking about. Patch test first!! Be very careful with this, the bumps took a week to go away.

avis.titre: 1 Star – Would Give Zero If I Could
avis.texte: Please be careful with this sunscreen. I don't even consider my skin super sensitive, but The Ordinary's new sunscreen gave me one of the worst allergic reactions I've ever had. Within hours, I broke out in painful hives all over my face. Antihistamines didn't help—I've been on steroids for a week now and still have a rash that won't go away. I bought this hoping it would be a good alternative to my favorite sunscreen from Natrium, but it was a huge mistake. I truly wish I had never tried it. If you have even mildly reactive skin, I strongly recommend avoiding this product. I wouldn't wish this experience on anyone.

Please believe all of the users who said that this is very sensitive for people with sensitive skin. The first day that I used this went really great. I am an African-American female with normal skin. I don't usually have any kind of reactions to products, and I have many products from this line, but after about three days of daily use, I noticed red, small bumps that were all over the skin where I used the sunscreen. Please believe the other users, this broke me out all over my lower jaw and neck, as well as in the corners of my eyes. I returned it expeditiously and I will never use this product again. I wish I could give it zero stars.

This product goes on beautifully and makes your skin glow, but even though theres no pore clogging ingredients in this sunscreen it caused some sort of reaction all over my face, neck and chest. after only using it for about a week i notcied closed comedones on my face and bumpy skin patches everywhere else i applied it.

Ive tried sooo many sunscreens and this one is the best. Ive always hated wearing sunscreen because of the way it felt, it was a sensory nightmare. This sunscreen sits so well on my face I dont feel it. 100/10 for me!

🌞 **Review of the New Ordinary Sunscreen** 🌞 Overall, this sunscreen was a bit of a letdown. 😕 **Pros:** ✅ No peeling! 🙌 ✅ Didn't burn my eyes! 👀✨ **Cons:** 😩 It's super sticky and doesn't seem to go away! 😳 Looks REALLY greasy! 🍳 I was hoping for a better experience! Keep searching for that perfect sunscreen! 🕵️‍♀️💦

avis.titre: Would not recommend for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I broke out in a horrible rash. Such a bunmer since the rest of my skincare primarily is from this brand.

I bought this suncreen a few days ago and have definitely put it to the test. It leaves zero white cast, has a beautiful glow, and sits great under my everyday makeup. I have been searching for a sunscreen that doesn't peel off my skin like the supergoop one and this product is at a great price especially considering it delivers SPF 45 protection. I will say it initially feels heavy on this skin so i wouldn't recommend to anyone with oily or greasy skin, however this is typical with most sunscreens and I find that it usually goes away after a half hour of it being on. This is definitely one of my new favorite sunscreens!

Tried this yesterday, no visible issues at first but today I woke up with itchy littld bumps all over my face! The skin around my eyes is red and rash- looking and burns to the touch. Should've read other reviews first but this is NOT for sensitive skin.

The forumla is very serum-like and leaves no white cast but is so too greasy to use makeup on top off. After four days I got clogged pores and small bumps that look like fungal acne EVERYWHERE I put the product. Even under my eyes and on my neck. Not safe if you have sensitive skin or fungal acne prone skin.

Tried it but ultimately decided to not purchase after looking af the ingredient label. Not greasy but the active ingredient is octocrylene which is known to damage reefs. If you're going to the beach, opt for a zinc oxide or titanium dioxide (non-nano) sunscreen instead.

This product caused my skin to get super irritated and swell up causing a lot of itchyness , would not recommend if you're sensitive to a lot of skincare. Never happened with my beauty of joseon sunscreen!!

avis.titre: I must have in my routine
avis.texte: I've been using The Ordinary's sunscreen for a few weeks now, and overall, it's a solid option if you're looking for a budget-friendly, mineral-based SPF. The formula is fragrance-free, which is great for sensitive skin, and I appreciate the added antioxidants for extra protection. However, it does have a thick texture and can leave a noticeable white cast—especially on deeper skin tones—which might make it hard to wear under makeup or for everyday use if you're looking for a more invisible finish. It also takes a bit of effort to fully rub in, but once absorbed, it feels moisturizing and not greasy. I'd recommend this for people with dry to normal skin who prioritize clean ingredients and don't mind a little extra blending. If you have oily skin or want something sheer and lightweight, this might not be your top pick. Complimentary from theordinary
